ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy mount (same capsule section as glass protocol)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Same capsule section as silicate glass; sulfide grains ≥20 µm selected by SEM-BSE
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system; same system as glass protocol)
ada:ablationCellType: Cetac Analyte HE system (same as silicate glass protocol)
ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault: 20 µm circular (sulfide; grain sizes >20 µm selected)
ada:ablationDurationPerSpotDefault: ~40 s (same protocol; grain size >20 µm selected)
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He (flow rate not stated; same system as glass protocol)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element from EMP: Fe (FeOT from EMP for sulfide); NIST 610 as external standard
ada:internalStandardElement: Fe from EMP (FeOT wt% for sulfide)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Fe IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield; micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes and excluded from integration
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Same approach as glass; micronugget identification from Au signal spikes critical for sulfide analyses
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST 610 (primary external standard); Fe from EMP as IS
ada:calibrationStandardMeasurementFreque: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (same monitoring standard set as glass protocol)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Sulfide Au and Cu concentrations consistent with strong positive correlation with log fS₂ (Fig. 5A) confirming thermodynamic equilibrium; partitioning coefficients Dsulfide/melt consistent with literature (Li et al. 2019, 2021)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Same approach as glass; Au spike identification critical for determining solubility vs. nugget contribution

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: N₂ or Ar mixed (same protocol as glass)
